verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents deploying or running the core Elastic Observability stack on self-managed infrastructure. The llms.txt probe calls Elastic an 'open source' platform and the docs describe it as 'open by design', but neither states that the core product can be self-hosted. The container and Fleet Server items cover running collection agents, not hosting the core product, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
